definition-section.comment: TEST/STEP DEFINITION blocks hold prose values. Inside them only comments, macros and the fixed field keys are highlighted — numbers, literals and constants in descriptions are left as default text.
definition-section.name: meta.definition.esi

comments.comment: A '#' starts a line comment to end-of-line. Listed first so macros/tags inside a comment are not separately highlighted.
comments.name: comment.line.number-sign.esi

tags.comment: Section / component tags: [NAME] and [/NAME]. Component connections ([429_…], [ED_…], …) are re-coloured by the semantic-token provider.

field-keys.comment: Any `key =` left-hand side (section keys like 'Step Description', 'system call', 'result file', 'time', message field names, …). Coloured as a keyword; message field keys inside component blocks are re-coloured (orange) by the semantic-token provider.

file-paths.comment: File-path values: a path-like token (folders with / or \ separators, optional drive letter) ending in a short alphabetic extension — e.g. ../../Utilities/DumpReadLog.py, C:\dir\file.csv, report.html, tool.exe. Extension-agnostic (any 1–7 letter extension) so new types like .exe/.html need no list; numeric suffixes (1.5, 192.168.0.1) and N/A are excluded because the extension must start with a letter.
file-paths.name: string.other.path.esi

folder-paths.comment: Directory paths without a file extension — e.g. folder/subfolder, folder\subfolder\, ../../Utilities/, C:\dir\. Same colour as file paths. Requires a separator after a ./ ../ drive, or a 2+ char segment, so values like N/A are not matched.
folder-paths.name: string.other.path.esi

strings.comment: Double-quoted string literals used as values.
strings.name: string.quoted.double.esi

numbers.comment: Integers, decimals, hex and signed/exponent forms — only as standalone tokens, never inside identifiers like DO-260B_11503.
numbers.name: constant.numeric.esi
